name: new-order-modal-category-fix
title: Fix new order modal category contract
description: Fix the manager new-order modal crash caused by treating Menu.categoryMenu as an array of dish categories.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: NewOrderModal now loads the restaurant-scoped dish Category list through useCategoryManagement instead of iterating the singular Menu.categoryMenu object. The helper defensively accepts only arrays and preserves the existing Khác fallback for orphaned or uncategorized items. Added focused regression coverage. A standalone Node smoke check passed. Vitest, frontend build, and browser smoke were not run because the connector environment does not contain a repository checkout and outbound git access is unavailable.
